Lady '''Leilwin''' was a noblewoman from the area around Tanchico. She became a refugee when her estates were burned by [[Dragonsworn]].{{ref/book|c|{{PAGENAME}}||Leilwin, Lady}}

==Activities==
[[Floran Gelb]] mistook her for a ''[[sul'dam]]'' and kidnapped her for Egeanin Tamarath. After discovering the mistake, Egeanin had her sent off in a courier boat to become ''[[da'covale]]''.{{ref/book|4|38}}

==Trivia==
While traveling with [[Mat Cauthon]] in [[Valan Luca's Traveling Show]], Egeanin uses the alias Leilwin,{{ref/book|10|1}} most likely because it is a Taraboner (or, more relevantly, non-Seanchan) name, which likely came to mind because of the events surrounding Lady Leilwin. [[Tuon]] renames Egeanin "Leilwin Shipless" as punishment for her treason. The name Leilwin Shipless was suggested by [[Selucia]] after Tuon asked what name Egeanin was using.{{ref/book|10|28}}
